title: SchemaInferenceLimits
description: Limits on the column children that ingestion infers from sampled JSON values: objects in data files, NoSQL documents, and JSON columns read with Extract JSON Schema. Declared schemas (JSON Schema files, Avro, Parquet, Iceberg or Delta metadata) are never limited.

maxSchemaInferenceDepth.title: Max Schema Inference Depth
maxSchemaInferenceDepth.description: Maximum nesting depth of column children inferred from sampled JSON values. The direct children of a column are depth 1. Deeper children are not ingested, and a column at the limit keeps its data type without children. 0 keeps no inferred children. Leave empty for no limit.

maxChildrenPerColumn.title: Max Children Per Column
maxChildrenPerColumn.description: Maximum number of direct children kept for any column inferred from sampled JSON values, applied at every nesting level. When a column has more, the children whose names sort first are kept, so every run keeps the same children whatever the order of the sampled records. 0 keeps no inferred children. Leave empty for no limit.
